assertions.text: Creates deterministic testpoints with a naming dictionary and TP IDs
assertions.script: FILE=testspec/changes/synthetic-reporting-console/specs/testpoints.md && test -f "$FILE" && grep -q '命名字典' "$FILE" && grep -qE 'TP_[A-Z]+_[A-Z]+_[0-9]+' "$FILE" && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Marks the unresolved oracle explicitly instead of fabricating a rule
Does not force the high-impact access ambiguity to P3
Propagates revision 2 and resolves the points stale marker
